baseline_plan.title: Soft blanket layer on chair seat
baseline_plan.summary: Place a folded blanket on the office chair seat to create a soft resting surface for a small fragile object.

steps.action: Unfold blanket_01 and lay it flat on the seat of office_chair_01
steps.why_it_helps: Provides a soft cushioning layer to protect the fragile object from the hard chair surface.

assumptions: The blanket provides adequate cushioning for the fragile object.
The chair seat is clean and can support the blanket without slipping.
unresolved_risks: The blanket may shift during use, potentially exposing the object to the hard chair surface.
The fragile object may roll or slide off the blanket if not centered.
constraint_check: Only used inventory objects: blanket_01 and office_chair_01 (external resource: small fragile object).
No permanent modifications made; items are placed temporarily.
No damage to any listed object anticipated.
No claims made about slip, water, impact protection beyond providing soft cushioning.
